items.t: Mobile App — Filtered benign cancelled-network-request errors out of iOS crash and error monitoring.
Mobile App — Added telemetry to measure whether push notification deep links successfully open the target screen.
Mobile App — Delayed the navigation loading spinner so fast screen loads no longer flash it.
Mobile App — Fixed an issue where the app could crash on iOS while loading a screen.
Method Pay — Enabled Tap to Pay as a payment option in stock Payment, Sales Receipt, and Donation checkouts.
Payments — Removed the legacy Tap to Phone charge type and retired the temporary reveal flag for the checkbox payment flow.
DevOps — Added automated unit and integration test coverage for the billing subscription service.
Method AI — Patched Method AI's production containers to a Node.js version with several security fixes.
Method AI — Fixed an issue where AI-built filters inside loops could point at the wrong value or come out empty.
Method AI — Improved Method AI to use built-in condition operators instead of extra steps for text-matching checks.
Method AI — Removed session tokens from Method AI traces sent to the tracing service.
Method AI — Cleaned up Method AI's loop-context handling for filters built inside list loops.
Method AI — Added the ability to stop and roll back an in-progress AI screen customization.
Method AI — Improved Method AI's guidance so it correctly diagnoses when Row Click doesn't fire on an editable grid.
Method AI — Fixed an issue where Method AI said no changes were made after successfully saving a grid column or dropdown edit.
Method AI — Fixed an issue where Method AI rejected a valid change because of unrelated, pre-existing errors in the automation.
Method AI — Added support for removing grid column validation rules and setting custom Yes/No labels through Method AI.
Method AI — Fixed an issue where asking Method AI to disable or enable an action could delete it, leave it unchanged, or time out.
Method AI — Fixed an issue where stopping an in-progress AI request cleared the typed prompt from the chat box.
Method AI — Migrated Method AI's cache connections to the upgraded Valkey clusters with TLS and account-based authentication.
Method AI — Enhanced the reset summary to name which validation rule changed instead of a generic message.
User Permissions — Fixed an issue where removing a Super Admin's permissions appeared to save but had no effect.
Sign-in — Added automated test coverage for the sign-in service.
Sign-in — Migrated sign-in's cache connection to support TLS and account-based authentication on the upgraded cache clusters.
Import/Export — Migrated Import/Export's cache connection to support TLS and account-based authentication on the upgraded cache clusters.
Classic — Migrated the classic CRM's cache connection to support TLS and account-based authentication on the upgraded cache clusters.
QBDT — Fixed an issue where line custom field edits on Sales Orders, Purchase Orders, Invoices, Credit Memos, and Estimates reverted or went blank after syncing with QuickBooks Desktop.
DevOps — Added contract test verification for the authentication endpoints used by QuickBooks Online sync.
DevOps — Added contract test verification for the account service's cluster lookup used by QuickBooks Online sync.
DevOps — Added contract test verification for the Intuit token endpoints used by QuickBooks Online sync.
DevOps — Added contract test verification for the email endpoint used by QuickBooks Online sync.
QBDT — Fixed an issue where QuickBooks Desktop's transaction history sync setting offered a Skip option that didn't work.
REST API — Fixed an issue where REST API aggregate queries rejected aliases containing special characters.
Dashboard — Removed unnecessary backend checks for the Home page feature flag, reducing page load delay.
